ops.title: kubectl EKS exec runs cc-remote key, not aws eks get-token
ops.body: cc-remote v0.27.43 (#158) answers aws eks get-token in-process by presigning STS GetCallerIdentity locally. ~/.kube/config on the launcher Mac now runs /opt/homebrew/bin/cc-remote key -- aws ... for all 17 EKS users; the backup is ~/.kube/config.bak-aws-exec-20261112. Rerunning aws eks update-kubeconfig (forgectl kube, tenantsmoke, sandsql-rig) rewrites that user back to aws. A drive job (durable-agents j2722 test.zsh) copies the kubeconfig and strips the wrapper on purpose. Measured over 5-minute samples: 0.6/min aws eks get-token before, 0 from ~/.kube/config after, and 1.0/min from that job's private kubeconfig. Forge-AI/monorepo#55483 cuts artifact.sh presign from 3 aws calls to 1.
